headline: Chilean Fish Producer Blumar Triples Nine-Month Profit
summary: Chile's Blumar earned $78.8 million in the first nine months of the year, bolstered by high fishmeal and fish oil prices as it negotiates a salmon sale.
why: Blumar is a significant player in Chile's seafood and aquaculture export sector.

impacts.name: Blumar
impacts.why: Tripled net profits directly reflect strong operational earnings and favorable commodity pricing.
